name: 2021 01 13 No January Special Planning Commission Meeting
agenda_text:
The Planning Commission Meeting of
  Wednesday, which was scheduled
 January 6, 2021, along with the Special
Planning Commission Meeting scheduled
for January 13, 2021, have been canceled.

  There will be a Special Planning
  Commission Meeting on Wednesday,
  January 20, 2021, at 7:00 pm,
viewable on Inglewood’s Spectrum Cable
  Channel 35 and Facebook.
